containment parent

  • CURIE: gmeow:containmentParent
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containmentParent
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The containing (parent) place in this containment tenure. Functional: a single tenure has exactly one parent place.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ContainmentTenure -> gmeow:Place; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:containmentParent from gmeow:ContainmentTenure to gmeow:Place when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:ContainmentTenure, gmeow:Place

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the single containing (parent) place of a containment tenure; functional.

Avoid when

  • Avoid multiple parents on one tenure — disputed parallel parents are multiple standpoint-indexed tenures (Principle 9).

How to use

  • Set exactly one gmeow:containmentParent per ContainmentTenure.

Examples

  • ex:ct gmeow:containmentParent ex:countyOld.
